name: daily-hub
description: Agenda pessoal centrada no dia: tarefas, metas, anotações, compromissos e contatos interligados. Aplicação fullstack TypeScript (React + NestJS, monorepo) com demo ao vivo.

paragraphs: A day-centric personal hub — tasks, goals, notes, events and contacts, all interlinked.
Full-stack TypeScript in a typed monorepo (React + NestJS), with a design system built around one idea — daylight, calm focus.
features: Each feature is fully specified in docs/features/ — overview, business rules, flows (Mermaid) and technical notes.
End-to-end type safety — Zod schemas in packages/shared validate the API and type the client; validation lives in exactly one place.

A real design system — tokens (color, type, elevation, motion) as CSS variables, a unified status model, purposeful motion (Framer Motion), and accessibility by default (visible focus, prefers-reduced-motion).
Non-trivial domain logic — RRULE recurrence, presigned-URL uploads, a global JWT guard, and drag-and-drop status across three entity types (@dnd-kit).
Documented like a product — requirements (REQ-) and acceptance criteria (AC-) per feature, logged architecture decisions, and a MkDocs site.

whatItDoes.text: A day-centric personal hub — tasks, goals, notes, events and contacts, all interlinked.
